title: Amours qui si / Solem Iusticie leticie / Solem (anonymous, Montpellier Codex)
desc: Anonymous, Amours qui si / Solem Iusticie leticie / Solem. 3 voices (Triplum, Motetus, Tenor), each on its own staff.
